description.fallback: In Cairo, Polnareff sits in the street with a blanket over his head, trying to escape the heat. He is approached by a strange looking beggar. Polnareff tries to get away, but the beggar won't leave him alone, angered at Polnareff for "taking his customers." Avdol explains that in Cairo, the beggars have their own system, including territories and salaries.
